summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase A IronVision GRC restructure. All 19 backend tests passed (100%). All 19 frontend test cases passed. Features tested: Framework Workspace with compliance status management, SIEM evidence integration, AI assessment, policy suggestions, notes persistence, filters, Command Palette (Cmd+K), and Policy Hub with Mappings/Cross-Framework tabs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A restructure complete and verified. Framework Workspace shows per-control compliance with SIEM evidence, policy mappings, editable status/notes. Command Palette (Cmd+K) works for global navigation. Mappings and Cross-Framework tabs moved to Policy Hub.

login.details: Login with demo-admin@grc.com / DemoAdmin123! works correctly

framework_grid.details: /frameworks shows framework grid with View Details buttons

framework_workspace.details: Framework Workspace loads with summary cards, progress bar, filters, controls list

summary_cards.details: Shows Total, Compliant, Partial, Non-Compliant, Not Assessed counts

compliance_progress_bar.details: Shows compliance percentage with color-coded segments

control_list.details: Shows control IDs, titles, status badges, SIEM event counts, policy counts, category tags

control_detail_panel.details: Expandable panel with Overview, SIEM Evidence, Policies, Notes tabs

status_update.details: Clicking status buttons (Compliant/Partial/Non-Compliant/Not Assessed) updates control status via API

notes_persistence.details: Notes tab allows saving notes that persist after page reload

siem_evidence_tab.details: Shows SIEM events for technical controls with severity, event type, details, timestamp

suggest_policy_button.details: Suggest Policy button visible in Overview tab

ai_assess_all_button.details: AI Assess All button visible and triggers bulk AI assessment

filters.details: Search, Status filter, Category filter all work correctly

policy_hub_tabs.details: /policies has 5 tabs: Policy Builder, Policy Library, Document Analysis, Control Mappings, Cross-Framework

command_palette.details: Cmd+K opens command palette with search and navigation

back_button.details: Back button in workspace returns to framework grid

search_shortcut_button.details: Sidebar shows Search button with ⌘K shortcut hint
